issues.fix_directive: Branches below a triggerless guarded branch must textually carry the negation of each preceding triggerless guard (e.g. 'else if (queueLong && !waitAboveLimit)'). Relying on the implicit priority of else-if produces a formal model whose operations can fire nondeterministically — the extracted preconditions are not mutually exclusive. Conjoin '&& !<guard>' for each guard listed above.
